sentences.ar: جحا زرع شجرة زيتون وهو كبير بالعمر.
sentences.en: Juha planted an olive tree when he was old.

sentences.ar: جاره ضحك وقال: إنت مش رح تاكل منها.
sentences.en: His neighbour laughed and said: you will not eat from it.

sentences.ar: قال جحا: أنا بكلت من شجر ما زرعته.
sentences.en: Juha said: I ate from trees I did not plant.

sentences.ar: وحدا غيري رح ياكل من هاي.
sentences.en: And someone else will eat from this one.
